crossRefs.note: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me…
You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’ ” For, he said, “I will appease him with…
The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

people.name: Nabal
people.line: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.

translations.web: She said to her young men, “Go on before me. Behold, I am coming after you.” But she didn’t tell her husband, Nabal.
translations.bsb: and said to her young men, “Go ahead of me. I will be right behind you.” But she did not tell her husband Nabal.
translations.kjv: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.
translations.asv: And she said unto her young men, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.
